defmodule SecureVault.NativeBinding do
  @moduledoc """
  NIF bindings for hardware-accelerated encryption via JNI bridge.
  Uses AES-256-GCM with hardware security module integration.
  """

  @on_load :init
  @jni_lib_path Application.compile_env(:secure_vault, :jni_lib_path, "/opt/vault/lib")

  def init do
    path = resolve_library_path()
    :erlang.load_nif(String.to_charlist(path), 0)
  end

  defp resolve_library_path do
    base = @jni_lib_path
    arch = detect_architecture()
    Path.join([base, arch, "libvault_crypto"])
  end

  defp detect_architecture do
    case :erlang.system_info(:system_architecture) do
      arch when is_list(arch) -> List.to_string(arch)
      arch -> to_string(arch)
    end
  end

  # NIF stubs - replaced at load time
  def jni_encrypt(_plaintext, _key_ref, _nonce, _aad), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def jni_decrypt(_ciphertext, _key_ref, _nonce, _aad), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def jni_derive_key(_master_ref, _context, _length), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
  def jni_get_key_handle(_key_id), do: :erlang.nif_error(:not_loaded)
end

defmodule SecureVault.KeyManager do
  @moduledoc "Manages encryption key lifecycle with HSM backing."

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @key_rotation_interval_ms 3_600_000
  @max_cached_keys 16

  defstruct [:master_ref, :key_cache, :rotation_timer]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def get_encryption_context(tenant_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_context, tenant_id})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    master_key_id = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :master_key_id)
    master_ref = SecureVault.NativeBinding.jni_get_key_handle(master_key_id)
    timer = Process.send_after(self(), :rotate_keys, @key_rotation_interval_ms)

    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      master_ref: master_ref,
      key_cache: %{},
      rotation_timer: timer
    }}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get_context, tenant_id}, _from, state) do
    {key_ref, new_state} = resolve_tenant_key(tenant_id, state)
    {:reply, {:ok, key_ref}, new_state}
  end

  defp resolve_tenant_key(tenant_id, state) do
    case Map.get(state.key_cache, tenant_id) do
      nil ->
        context = build_derivation_context(tenant_id)
        key_ref = SecureVault.NativeBinding.jni_derive_key(
          state.master_ref, context, 32
        )
        new_cache = maybe_evict(state.key_cache, @max_cached_keys)
        {key_ref, %{state | key_cache: Map.put(new_cache, tenant_id, key_ref)}}

      cached_ref ->
        {cached_ref, state}
    end
  end

  defp build_derivation_context(tenant_id) do
    # Context includes tenant ID and epoch for key rotation binding
    epoch = div(System.system_time(:second), 3600)
    <<tenant_id::binary, 0x00, epoch::unsigned-big-integer-size(64)>>
  end

  defp maybe_evict(cache, max) when map_size(cache) >= max do
    {_k, _v, rest} = cache |> Enum.to_list() |> List.first() |> then(fn {k, v} ->
      {k, v, Map.delete(cache, k)}
    end)
    rest
  end
  defp maybe_evict(cache, _max), do: cache
end

defmodule SecureVault.CryptoService do
  @moduledoc "High-level encryption service for application data."

  alias SecureVault.{NativeBinding, KeyManager}
  require Logger

  @nonce_bytes 12
  @tag_bytes 16

  def encrypt_record(tenant_id, record_id, plaintext) when is_binary(plaintext) do
    with {:ok, key_ref} <- KeyManager.get_encryption_context(tenant_id) do
      aad = build_aad(tenant_id, record_id)
      nonce = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@nonce_bytes)

      case NativeBinding.jni_encrypt(plaintext, key_ref, nonce, aad) do
        {:ok, {ciphertext, tag}} ->
          # Pack: version || nonce || tag || ciphertext
          packed = <<1::8, nonce::binary-size(@nonce_bytes),
                     tag::binary-size(@tag_bytes), ciphertext::binary>>
          {:ok, packed}

        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("Encryption failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
          {:error, :encryption_failed}
      end
    end
  end

  def decrypt_record(tenant_id, record_id, packed) when is_binary(packed) do
    with {:ok, key_ref} <- KeyManager.get_encryption_context(tenant_id),
         {:ok, components} <- unpack_ciphertext(packed) do
      aad = build_aad(tenant_id, record_id)

      case NativeBinding.jni_decrypt(components.ciphertext, key_ref, components.nonce, aad) do
        {:ok, plaintext} ->
          {:ok, plaintext}

        {:error, :auth_failed} ->
          Logger.warning("Decryption auth failed for #{record_id}")
          {:error, :integrity_violation}

        {:error, reason} ->
          Logger.error("Decryption failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
          {:error, :decryption_failed}
      end
    end
  end

  defp unpack_ciphertext(<<1::8, nonce::binary-size(@nonce_bytes),
                           tag::binary-size(@tag_bytes), ciphertext::binary>>) do
    {:ok, %{version: 1, nonce: nonce, tag: tag, ciphertext: ciphertext}}
  end
  defp unpack_ciphertext(_), do: {:error, :invalid_format}

  defp build_aad(tenant_id, record_id) do
    # AAD binds ciphertext to tenant and record identity
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, tenant_id <> <<0x00>> <> record_id)
  end
end

defmodule SecureVault.StorageController do
  @moduledoc "Phoenix controller for encrypted record storage."

  use Phoenix.Controller, namespace: SecureVault
  import Plug.Conn
  require Logger

  alias SecureVault.CryptoService

  plug :authenticate
  plug :validate_tenant

  def store(conn, %{"record_id" => record_id, "data" => data}) do
    tenant_id = conn.assigns.tenant_id
    plaintext = Jason.encode!(data)

    case CryptoService.encrypt_record(tenant_id, record_id, plaintext) do
      {:ok, encrypted} ->
        encoded = Base.url_encode64(encrypted, padding: false)
        persist_to_storage(tenant_id, record_id, encoded)
        json(conn, %{status: "stored", record_id: record_id})

      {:error, _reason} ->
        conn |> put_status(500) |> json(%{error: "encryption_failed"})
    end
  end

  def retrieve(conn, %{"record_id" => record_id}) do
    tenant_id = conn.assigns.tenant_id

    with {:ok, encoded} <- fetch_from_storage(tenant_id, record_id),
         {:ok, packed} <- Base.url_decode64(encoded, padding: false),
         {:ok, plaintext} <- CryptoService.decrypt_record(tenant_id, record_id, packed) do
      json(conn, %{record_id: record_id, data: Jason.decode!(plaintext)})
    else
      {:error, :integrity_violation} ->
        Logger.alert("Integrity violation for tenant=#{tenant_id} record=#{record_id}")
        conn |> put_status(403) |> json(%{error: "integrity_check_failed"})

      {:error, _} ->
        conn |> put_status(404) |> json(%{error: "not_found"})
    end
  end

  defp authenticate(conn, _opts) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "authorization") do
      ["Bearer " <> token] -> verify_and_assign(conn, token)
      _ -> conn |> put_status(401) |> json(%{error: "unauthorized"}) |> halt()
    end
  end

  defp verify_and_assign(conn, token) do
    case SecureVault.Auth.verify_token(token) do
      {:ok, claims} ->
        case Map.get(claims, "tenant_id") do
          tenant_id when is_binary(tenant_id) and byte_size(tenant_id) > 0 ->
            assign(conn, :tenant_id, tenant_id)

          _ ->
            conn |> put_status(401) |> json(%{error: "unauthorized"}) |> halt()
        end

      {:error, _} ->
        conn |> put_status(401) |> json(%{error: "unauthorized"}) |> halt()
    end
  end

  defp validate_tenant(conn, _opts), do: conn

  defp persist_to_storage(tenant_id, record_id, data) do
    key = "#{tenant_id}:#{record_id}"
    SecureVault.Store.put(key, data)
  end

  defp fetch_from_storage(tenant_id, record_id) do
    key = "#{tenant_id}:#{record_id}"
    SecureVault.Store.get(key)
  end
end
